source_of_truth.rule: This is the single executable per-card contract. The starter JSON owns the authored pixels/geometry; the registry owns the built card index and renderer route; graphic-templates owns the mode grammar. The planner freezes this contract into the Scene Graph; the renderer only executes the frozen text/media.
